# Yapper (ypr.app)

> Yapper Studio is an all-in-one content creation studio for talking-to-camera video, made by OCX Software Inc. It takes one video from idea capture to an AI-assisted script, a teleprompter recording, one-click and transcript-based editing, automatic captions, a content calendar and cross-posting to YouTube, TikTok and Instagram.

Key facts:
- Platforms: web (ideas, scripts, scheduling and publishing) and the desktop Studio app on Mac (recording and editing). Mobile is coming soon. Windows is not available yet. Yapper is not Mac-only.
- Price: one Studio membership, $24.99 a month or $199.99 a year, with AI credits. 7-day free trial with 100 credits. Writing, recording and editing by hand use no credits.
- You record the video yourself. Yapper does not replace you with an AI avatar.
- Made by OCX Software Inc.; founder Can Gurel. Not affiliated with other apps, sites or tokens named Yapper.
- Speaking practice moved from ypr.app to its own product, Speaking Practice (speakingpractice.ai), in October 2026.
